_comment: Per-game local tweaks, merged over the platform defaults.
Key by id, or by platform/id when the same id exists on several platforms.
target:   glob for the file to launch, relative to the installed game
args:     replaces the emulator's argsTemplate entirely
unzip:    unpack a zipped ROM into a directory after download, for
emulators that cannot read an archive

n64/usa.legend_of_zelda_majoras_mask.comment: Native PC port, not emulation. It extracts its assets from a bare .z64 on first run, so the No-Intro zip has to be unpacked.
